reason: I've got two clients I'm fairly sure are taking the mick on usage, and a free audit with a 'don't pay unless it finds a grand' guarantee costs me one call and an export. If it puts the ticket numbers behind those two, £99 a month is nothing next to one renewal uplift.
objection: Our ticket categories are a mess, so I expect half the 'unbilled' findings to be wrong or arguable, and then I've wasted my ops lead's week arguing with a report. I've bought reporting before that nobody looked at after month one.
would_change_my_mind: If the first report is mostly noise from our miscategorised tickets and I have to clean it up myself, I cancel and don't come back.
